description: This file defines the NoteStore class for managing notes in the Notesnook application, including methods for refreshing, setting context, pinning, favoriting, archiving, locking, unlocking, duplicating, and setting colors for notes. It also exports a store hook and a function to retrieve notes based on context.

classes.name: NoteStore
classes.description: A class extending BaseStore to manage notes, including state for notes, context, view mode, and methods for manipulating notes such as refresh, setContext, delete, pin, favorite, archive, lock, unlock, duplicate, and setColor.

methods.name: setViewMode
methods.description: Sets the view mode ('detailed' or 'compact') and updates configuration.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches grouped notes from the database and updates the store, then refreshes the context.

methods.name: refreshContext
methods.description: Refreshes notes based on the current context.

methods.name: setContext
methods.description: Sets the current context and loads related notes based on context type.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Moves specified notes to trash and refreshes the store and trash store.

methods.name: favorite
methods.description: Marks or unmarks notes as favorite.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks a note via Vault and refreshes the store.

methods.name: readonly
methods.description: Sets notes as readonly or editable.

methods.name: updateDateCreated
methods.description: Updates the creation date of a note.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Associates or removes a color relation for notes.
